scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:cognitive
scripts.sync: sh -c 'PY=$(for p in "${PYTHON:-}" ../personal-blog-venv/bin/python python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 /usr/bin/python3; do [ -n "$p" ] && command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c "import bs4" 2>/dev/null && { echo "$p"; break; }; done); [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo "Missing Python with beautifulsoup4"; exit 1; }; "$PY" scripts/sync_chrome.py && "$PY" update_reading_links.py && "$PY" update_related_reading.py && "$PY" update_travel_overview.py && "$PY" generate_search_index.py && "$PY" generate_sitemap.py'
scripts.test: sh -c 'PY=$(for p in "${PYTHON:-}" ../personal-blog-venv/bin/python python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 /usr/bin/python3; do [ -n "$p" ] && command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c "import bs4" 2>/dev/null && { echo "$p"; break; }; done); [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo "Missing Python with beautifulsoup4"; exit 1; }; "$PY" -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node --test tests/*.test.cjs'
scripts.check: sh -c 'PY=$(for p in "${PYTHON:-}" ../personal-blog-venv/bin/python python3 python3.14 python3.13 python3.12 /usr/bin/python3; do [ -n "$p" ] && command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$p" -c "import bs4" 2>/dev/null && { echo "$p"; break; }; done); [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo "Missing Python with beautifulsoup4"; exit 1; }; npm test && "$PY" validate_site.py && "$PY" scripts/audit_projects_meta.py && "$PY" scripts/sync_chrome.py --check && "$PY" update_reading_links.py --check && "$PY" update_related_reading.py --check && "$PY" update_travel_overview.py --check && "$PY" generate_search_index.py --check && "$PY" generate_sitemap.py --check'
